name: Hawala and Money or Value Transfer Services for Terrorist Financing
description: Informal value transfer systems and unregulated or poorly supervised MVTS can move funds across borders using settlement by trade, netting or cash, leaving limited records. They are important to many legitimate communities but can be abused to transfer money to terrorist actors in regions with limited banking access.

sources.text: FATF, The Role of Hawala and Other Similar Service Providers in Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2013)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: Money or Value Transfer Services (2016)

exposure.rationale: Informal and poorly supervised MVTS operators with pooled accounts, structured cash and trade-based settlement to conflict areas.

indicators.name: Operator account with transactions inconsistent with a retail remittance profile
indicators.canon: Operator account with transactions inconsistent with a retail remittance profile
indicators.desc: Business accounts of an MVTS or agent receive large pooled deposits and send bulk payments to a small set of foreign counterparties.
indicators.ctx: Business accounts of an MVTS or agent receive large pooled deposits and send bulk payments to a small set of foreign counterparties.

indicators.name: Unlicensed operator or no evidence of registration
indicators.canon: Missing, misused or unverifiable licence or registration
indicators.desc: Customer offering a regulated or permitted activity cannot evidence the required licence or registration, or operates under a licence held by another party.
indicators.ctx: Customer offers transfers but cannot evidence registration or supervision.
indicators.fp: Small agents of licensed principals may hold no own licence.

indicators.name: Structured cash deposits across branches followed by overseas settlement
indicators.canon: Cash deposits split across branches, ATMs or accounts
indicators.desc: Cash is deposited in several locations, channels or accounts on the same day or over a short period so that no single deposit stands out.
indicators.ctx: Numerous cash deposits below thresholds by different people into one account, then wires to settlement partners.
indicators.fp: Cash-heavy communities and retail trades show similar patterns.

indicators.name: Settlement via trade, with mismatched invoices
indicators.canon: Settlement via trade, with mismatched invoices
indicators.desc: Offsetting flows are arranged through trade payments unrelated to the underlying goods.
indicators.ctx: Offsetting flows are arranged through trade payments unrelated to the underlying goods.
indicators.fp: Genuine trade can be netted among related firms.

indicators.name: Payments to or from higher-risk jurisdictions without clear relationship
indicators.canon: Payments or activity in jurisdictions unrelated to the customer's business or goods
indicators.desc: Payments, counterparties or sales originate in or go to countries with no link to the customer, declared business, services or goods.
indicators.ctx: Transfers to recipients in conflict-affected areas with no documented relationship or stated purpose.
indicators.fp: Many families lack documentation but have genuine needs.

indicators.name: Poor or missing sender and recipient information in transfers
indicators.canon: Missing, incomplete or placeholder originator and beneficiary information
indicators.desc: Payment messages omit, truncate or use generic placeholder data for originator or beneficiary details.
indicators.ctx: Payment messages lack complete originator or beneficiary details.
indicators.fp: Systems limitations may cause incomplete data.

indicators.name: Agent network with rapid expansion in higher-risk locations
indicators.canon: Agent network with rapid expansion in higher-risk locations
indicators.desc: Operator adds agents quickly in areas with terrorist presence without strengthened oversight.
indicators.ctx: Operator adds agents quickly in areas with terrorist presence without strengthened oversight.
indicators.fp: Growth in diaspora markets is common.

indicators.name: Linked parties with previous suspicious reports or designation
indicators.canon: Ownership or controllers linked to designated or previously reported parties
indicators.desc: Owners, officers or associates match sanctions or designation lists, prior suspicious reports or adverse media.
indicators.ctx: Operator, owners or agents match prior reports, adverse media or designation lists.
